# Christophe Beck on TBPN: How We Can Scale AI the Right Way


October 7, 2026


Ecolab Chairman, President and CEO Christophe Beck joined TBPN to discuss the massive infrastructure buildout underway to support artificial intelligence and the critical role water will play in enabling that growth.


The conversation explores how water touches every part of the AI value chain, from chips to power to cooling, and how smarter water management and advanced cooling technologies can help the industry scale more efficiently. Beck shares why Ecolab sees an opportunity to help the technology industry grow while respecting water resources and communities.
